info.description: A real certification or payment-trust seal shown in the footer (e-Namad, Digipay). Distinct from site.trust-item, which is an icon-and-text service promise, not a certification.

title.description: Accessible name / alt text, e.g. «نماد اعتماد الکترونیکی».

image.description: The official seal artwork supplied by the provider. Optional for e-Namad: when empty, the seal is served from trustseal.enamad.ir using enamadId/enamadCode.

verificationUrl.description: Where the seal links. Optional for e-Namad: derived from enamadId/enamadCode when empty.

enamadId.description: e-Namad only. The `id` value from the code issued at enamad.ir.

enamadCode.description: e-Namad only. The `Code` value from the code issued at enamad.ir. Also the id the e-Namad verifier expects on the element.
